mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO etf_fund_flow_summary ( etf_code, etf_name, trade_date, fund_share_today, share_change, close_price, fund_flow, cumulative_flow, ann_date, change_reason ) SELECT f.etf_code, m.symbol AS etf_name, f.trade_date, f.fund_share_today, f.share_change, f.close_price, f.fund_flow, 0 AS cumulative_flow, f.ann_date, f.change_reason FROM ( SELECT t1.etf_code, t1.change_date AS trade_date, t1.ann_date, t1.fund_share AS fund_share_today, COALESCE(t1.fund_share - LAG(t1.fund_share) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.etf_code ORDER BY t1.change_date), 0) AS share_change, t3.close_price, ROUND( COALESCE(t1.fund_share - LAG(t1.fund_share) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.etf_code ORDER BY t1.change_date), 0) * COALESCE(t3.close_price, 0) * 10000, 2 ) AS fund_flow, t1.change_reason FROM etf_fund_share t1 LEFT JOIN etf_market_kline t3 ON t1.etf_code = t3.etf_code AND t3.trade_time = t1.change_date WHERE t1.change_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) f LEFT JOIN etf_security_master m ON f.etf_code = m.etf_code
mapper.update: UPDATE etf_fund_flow_summary t JOIN ( SELECT etf_code, trade_date, SUM(fund_flow) OVER (PARTITION BY etf_code ORDER BY trade_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_flow FROM etf_fund_flow_summary WHERE trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) c ON t.etf_code = c.etf_code AND t.trade_date = c.trade_date SET t.cumulative_flow = c.cum_flow
